SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Laboratory 
WHERE IGG > 900 AND IGG < 2000 
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM Examination 
    WHERE Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID 
    AND Symptoms IS NOT NULL
)
